svg.title: Audiograms of three people
svg.desc: Hearing threshold level, in decibels relative to the normal threshold and increasing downward, versus frequency from 250 to 8000 Hz, for the right ear (circles) and left ear (diamonds). Top: normal hearing, with both ears within about 5 dB of 0 at every frequency. Middle: a child who suffered hearing loss from a cap gun, with normal thresholds except a sharp dip to about 55 dB at 4000 Hz in both ears. Bottom: presbycusis, age-related hearing loss, with thresholds that worsen steadily with frequency, reaching about 30 to 40 dB at 4000 Hz and 55 to 60 dB at 8000 Hz; brackets show the bone-conduction thresholds.
